summary: Phase 7 (final phase) attempted: the independent Hintikka-alignment rfl bridge was already landed by a prior dispatch (re-verified clean). A genuine, concrete attempt to close 9-B (wire modalStepBranchS4_worldBound into Decidable (s4Valid phi) fuel sufficiency) surfaced a structural gap not previously documented: the REAL decision procedure modalTableauS4 runs modalApplyOneS4/blockingWorldS4 (a LIVE-relevant-set guard), while S4LoopInv and modalStepBranchS4_worldBound (Phases 4-6) are proven only for the KEYED SHADOW stepper modalStepBranchS4Keyed/blockingWorldS4Keyed (a stable-birth-key guard) -- confirmed directly in modalStepBranchS4_preserves_S4LoopInv's hypothesis, which takes modalStepBranchS4Keyed as its step function, not modalStepBranchS4. Since S4LoopInv.keyLowerBd only gives keys subset-of live relevant sets (not equality), the live-set freshness guarantee blockingWorldS4_none_fresh does not imply keys-freshness -- the world-bound guarantee is proven about a driver modalTableauS4 does not run. Also discovered that task 515 (concurrent/later) already landed a more general Aux-parametrized rank-free top-loop lemma (modalExpandBranchesHintikka, CompletenessLoop.lean) built for S5, which is useful groundwork for the 9-A follow-on but does not by itself close S4 (wrapping keys in an existential Aux does not avoid the same guard-mismatch argument). Marked Phase 7 [BLOCKED] in the plan with this precise finding; recommend spawning the 9-A follow-on task with this sharpened scope. No sorry/axiom/vacuous placeholder introduced. Phases 1-6 (the original task 506 Phase 8 world-bound deliverable) remain a valid, self-contained, fully sorry-free artifact regardless of Phase 7's outcome. Both lake build Cslib.Logics.Modal.Tableau.LoopChecking and .FrameCompleteness green; lean_verify clean on all re-checked lemmas.

blockers.what_was_tried: Traced modalTableauS4's actual definition (modalTableauGen (modalApplyOneS4 phi) phi, guarded by blockingWorldS4) against S4LoopInv/modalStepBranchS4_worldBound's actual proof target (modalStepBranchS4Keyed, guarded by blockingWorldS4Keyed). Confirmed via the theorem signature of modalStepBranchS4_preserves_S4LoopInv (hypothesis is modalStepBranchS4Keyed ... = some (...), not modalStepBranchS4) that the world-bound machinery is proven for a keyed shadow stepper distinct from the real decision procedure. Verified the two guards are not interchangeable: keyLowerBd gives keys subset-of relevantSetFinset (not equality), so blockingWorldS4_none_fresh's live-set freshness contract does not imply keys-freshness -- this is the same class of gap Phase 5's own guard redesign (introducing blockingWorldS4Keyed as a second guard) was built to route around, now re-encountered from the Decidable-instance side. Surveyed task 515's newly-landed Aux-parametrized modalExpandBranchesHintikka (CompletenessLoop.lean, more general than the modalExpandBranchesGen_hintikka this task's research evaluated) and confirmed wrapping keys in an existential Aux does not avoid the mismatch, since AuxStepPreserved would still need the same insufficient live-guard argument.
blockers.root_cause: modalTableauS4 (the real driver Decidable (s4Valid phi) must run) and modalStepBranchS4Keyed (the driver S4LoopInv/the pigeonhole world bound are proven for) are two distinct stepping functions with two distinct minting guards (blockingWorldS4 live-set-based vs blockingWorldS4Keyed birth-key-based). Phases 4-6 built the termination bound entirely around the keyed shadow driver as a proof-internal construction; no bridge or driver-swap connecting it to the real modalTableauS4 was built (nor was one anticipated with this precision in the plan's original Phase 7 wording, which described 'wire fuel sufficiency from modalStepBranchS4_worldBound' as if it were a direct application).
blockers.what_is_needed: Either (a) a bespoke S4-specific top-level driver (modalExpandBranchesS4Keyed/modalTableauS4Keyed) built around modalStepBranchS4Keyed with its own full processNext-style fuel induction (RuleApply's fixed-per-call signature cannot thread keys across steps, so the generic modalExpandBranchesGen/modalTableauGen/even the new Aux-parametrized modalExpandBranchesHintikka cannot be reused directly), plus re-verification that soundness (modalTableauS4_sound, task 506) and the truth lemma reconnect against the keyed guard (plausible in principle -- non-minting behavior and blocked-target-has-content contracts agree between the two guards -- but unverified); or (b) generalizing the driver framework itself (RuleApply/Accessibility or a new wrapper) to carry extra opaque per-branch threaded state generically, a materially larger 9-A than originally scoped.
